programs: The project is to deliver the expansion and upgrade of the existing Frankston Basketball Stadium at 90 Bardia Avenue, Seaford, Victoria.
Provide financial support to local councils to deliver priority local road and community infrastructure projects.
The Jubilee Park Indoor Stadium project will construct courts, amenities and supporting infrastructure.

The Lloyd Park Redevelopment project will construct a new two-storey pavilion and will include female friendly amenities, storage areas, first aid rooms, canteen, kitchen, toilets, meeting rooms, social room and lift.

The Redevelopment of RF Miles Recreation Reserve project will construct a new netball court, female-friendly facilities and public toilets, upgrade the existing AFL oval, new oval box, signage, fencing and landscaping.
The grant activity will upgrade an existing 7km trail from Frankston to McClellgan Sculpture Park and Gallery into an art trail.
